text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *sigh*... ...*sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(――...Footsteps...? Must be the folks out 
for a run...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Listen to this! I'm gonna be running in 
an Open race next!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So keep me company for morning training 
tomorrow too, okay? ...My dear 
graded-stakes winner♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, I got it. Come on, let's keep 
going."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Coming! Heave-ho, heave-ho, heave-ho...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The others have been putting in the miles 
too, huh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how early I leave home, there 
are always folks out running before me...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (—I have to do more.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (—You can do better than that, can't you?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Funininini......! Ngigigigi......!
choice_data_list:
Shall we switch to something a little 
lighter?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Not... fine... at all—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *sigh*... *yawn*...
choice_data_list: Break time! Make sure to stay hydrated!

It's break time! Make sure to stay 
hydrated!

text_block_list.text:
Ever since being given a space all to 
herself, Espoir City has focused on 
training, steadily building up her core 
strength.

Lately, however... it feels like she's hit 
a sudden plateau. If placed in an 
environment where she can concentrate, she 
should grow, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
This gym... It's reserved for us right 
now, but do other Umamusume usually use it 
too?
choice_data_list: ...? Yeah, I think some girls use it.

...? Yeah, I think some of the girls use 
it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So there are folks who can actually pull 
off the muscle training that I can't, huh?

—And a few days later, an even bigger 
change became apparent.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hahe... hahe—...
choice_data_list: (Espo's time is— dropping!?)

text_block_list.text:
"Her time worsening wasn't the half of it. 
Even running distances she easily handled 
before left her gasping for breath..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Oi, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You're running... one more lap...?
choice_data_list: No, hold on a second. Um, next is...
No, hold on. Um, next is...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What the... hell... Pulling out that 
'textbook' again...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Fine then, I'll wait up for you... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: A-Asleep?!

text_block_list.text:
"...Just when I thought we'd dealt with 
the concentration issue, another 
mysterious problem dropped right on top of 
us."
A new entry is added to the "textbook."

"Mandatory Action: In the event Espoir 
City is unable to perform at her usual 
level."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Hey, Espoir City! Playing Sleeping 
Beauty?
choice_data_list: ...Tap Dance City?

text_block_list.text:
I straightened my posture at the 
unexpected visitor. Tap Dance City is a 
formidable Umamusume with two GⅠ victories 
under her belt.

Unlike Espoir City who runs on dirt, she 
runs in turf races, so their main 
battlegrounds should be different, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's only natural if she's tired. 
Let her sleep a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
She was just bickering with me this 
morning, too.
choice_data_list: ...? 'Clashed'? Who did?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ? Espo, of course! Who else?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, running next to her is so much 
fun. She comes at you with this fierce 
momentum like she's definitely gonna eat 
you alive!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Training alongside Espo makes for a great 
warm-up on my end, too.
choice_data_list:
Wait up! ...Espo matched strides with you? 
When?

Wait! ...Espo matched strides with you? 
When?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you listening? This morning! I 
told you just a moment ago, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...If you're curious, do you want to come 
take a look?

The next day. I headed to the place Tap 
Dance City had mentioned. And there—
—There the two of them were.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Morning, Espo! Did you get a good night's 
rest?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I slept, all right! Hurry up and get in 
position!

...Apparently, this morning training 
started about a week or two ago. It began 
when Espoir City invited them out.
choice_data_list: (—I had no idea…)

text_block_list.text:
"If she was going head-to-head with a GⅠ 
Umamusume, it's only natural she'd be worn 
down physically and mentally. And to have 
been doing that since morning..."

At this rate... it's no wonder my body 
won't move during the day.

No matter how motivated or focused you 
are, pushing too hard will naturally take 
its toll. As a result, the quality of 
training drops too—
choice_data_list: (Why would you do this behind my back...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *wheeze*—... *wheeeeeze*—...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Tap... one more time--
choice_data_list:
No good, Espo. You're overworking 
yourself.
No, Espo. You're overworking yourself.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah... huh? Why is Trainer... w-wait...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Tap! Don't tell me you're—
choice_data_list:
We're taking today off training as well. 
Got it?

We're taking today off training as well. 
Okay?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... Don't make such a scary face. 
Espo didn't mean to—
choice_data_list:
She went quiet just now because she 
"understands".

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Do you understand?

Deep down, Espoir City surely knows it 
herself. That she is pushing her training 
too far.

"...Which is precisely why she kept this 
solo training a secret. So that her 
trainer wouldn't find out."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what!? Uh... Espo? Don't tell me... 
are we doing this training behind your 
Trainer's back...?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I can do it, you know.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I can do this! Both the morning training 
with Tap, and the afternoon training with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ordinary training just ain't gonna cut it! 
I gotta do at least as much as running 
with Tap!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I can do this! I can do it!! 
............I'm gonna...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
After all, she's a super strong 
Umamusume!!
choice_data_list: ...!! Hey, Espo!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ahh~... Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ……Sorry.
choice_data_list:
No, I'm the one who should apologize... 
It's not your fault
No, I'm sorry... It's not your fault

text_block_list.text:
The only one at fault is myself for 
failing to notice such overwork.
choice_data_list: ...Thanks for telling me.

text_block_list.text:
After thanking Tap Dance City for her 
help, I head back to the Academy.

I held my head in my hands. ...I need to 
properly check with Espoir City about what 
she was dissatisfied with.

Her training after her debut race should 
have gone smoothly. But instead, she 
pushed herself to overwork――

Her true feelings fill the open textbook. 
She blacks them out from above.

—Because you can't just stand still, 
wondering "why" and "I don't understand."

I declared today's training a 'rest day.' 
...Yet, following a hunch, I head toward 
the track.

—And the anxiety that crossed my mind 
became reality just like that.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Too slow.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Let's do this, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
...Ngh, before that, I want you to tell 
me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list: What was wrong with my training?

Was there something wrong with my 
training?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If I had a problem with it, I wouldn't 
bother coming every time.
choice_data_list: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Let's just get this over with. ...Our 
afternoon training, that is.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Look who else showed up here, bastard.

Her confusion deepens further. She grips 
her textbook tighter. Challenges come her 
way, one after another.
choice_data_list:
No good, you're taking today off! Your 
body...!

No, you're taking today off! Your body 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm not resting!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a strong horse girl. Don't look down 
on me! ...Don't you dare mock me!!"

"—If only she would drop that stubborn 
attitude, I could give her the most 
appropriate instructions."

Once again, the days of searching 
aimlessly for a breakthrough begin.

How can I stop her from overworking? How 
can I strip away the bravado that always 
drives her too hard?

"...However, I have no intention of giving 
up on coaching her. I will conquer this 
problem without fail."
